caption: The drawing depicts two objects: a circular, reddish-brown plate with a slightly darker rim and ochre-yellow wavy lines across its surface occupying the central area, and a smaller, crescent-shaped reddish-brown form positioned above and to the right of the plate, resembling a side profile of the same plate or a bowl. Both objects are outlined in white and set against a plain, beige background enclosed within a fine rectangular frame. The larger plate displays multiple wavy lines and a few small patches of lighter color, suggesting areas of reflection or texture. The drawing uses earthy tones including reddish-brown, ochre-yellow, and beige, with simple, clean lines to define the forms.
title: Plate
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
